central_object_or_phenomenon: Observed surface-water source classes in Naogaon, Chapainawabganj and Rajshahi; changing spatial/temporal support, 2000-2024.
intended_audience: Frontiers in Earth Science Hydrosphere, Original Research, Research Topic 83484.
kill_conditions: Cannot reproduce original annual extraction from unchanged inputs
Any required inference would need invented observations or false independent-reference provenance
last_change_rationale: Author explicitly delegated workstreams 1-7 and necessary evidence acquisition on 19 October 2026; paper identity retained.
main_question: How robust are annual seasonal/permanent source-class changes in northwestern Bangladesh to observation, cohort and climate specifications, and which independent, hydrological and recovery interpretations are supported?
minimum_publishable_claim: An evidence-bounded exploratory assessment of source-class changes and monitoring limitations; no assumed direction, accuracy or causal driver.
permitted_refinements: Simpler rainfall associations and chronological validation
pivot_triggers: A source/processing error invalidates reported values
Robustness eliminates support for a directional change

predecessor_failures: Independent accuracy not established by prior assisted labels
Recovery durations unidentifiable under nine prior settings
Earth Engine Python credentials unavailable at first scalar probe
primary_evidence_obligation: Retain original inputs, reproduce the original extraction, run frozen cohort/model sensitivities, and distinguish external independent labels from same-product agreement and simulated detectability.
reconsideration_gate: All seven requested workstreams have a measured result or an evidence-backed limitation; no desired-sign selection.
